[[SOURCE: ITB_Harbour_Sensors.txt | PAGE: 1]]
MERIDIAN COASTAL WORKS AGENCY
Invitation to Bid No. MCWA/ITB/2027/014
Supply, Installation and Calibration of Harbour Water-Level Sensors
Issue date: 2 May 2027
[[SOURCE: ITB_Harbour_Sensors.txt | PAGE: 2]]
BID DATA SHEET
Contracting Authority: Meridian Coastal Works Agency
Deadline for submission of bids: 28 June 2027 at 10:00 local time
Deadline for requests for clarification: 1 June 2027
Bid validity: 120 days from the deadline for submission of bids
Currency of bid: Euro (EUR)
Maximum budget: EUR 480,000 excluding VAT
[[SOURCE: ITB_Harbour_Sensors.txt | PAGE: 3]]
SECTION 1 - INSTRUCTIONS TO BIDDERS
1.1 The Agency invites sealed bids for the supply, installation and calibration of 24 water-level sensors at four harbours.
1.2 Bids shall be delivered in a sealed envelope to the Agency Registry, 14 Quay Street, Port Ellery, or uploaded to the e-procurement portal. Bids sent by e-mail will not be accepted.
1.3 Bids must be received no later than 30 June 2027 at 10:00 local time.
1.4 Bidders may submit questions in writing until the deadline for requests for clarification stated in the Bid Data Sheet.
1.5 Clarifications published by the Agency form an integral part of the tender documents and prevail over them.
[[SOURCE: ITB_Harbour_Sensors.txt | PAGE: 4]]
SECTION 2 - ELIGIBILITY AND QUALIFICATION
2.1 Bidders must be legally registered in their country of establishment.
2.2 Foreign bidders must submit a certified translation of their registration certificate, unless the certificate is issued in English or French.
2.3 The Bidder must have completed at least two contracts of similar nature, each with a value of not less than EUR 200,000, during the last five years.
2.4 The Bidder should demonstrate experience with tide-gauge or water-level telemetry systems.
2.5 Joint ventures are permitted. Each member of a joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable.
[[SOURCE: ITB_Harbour_Sensors.txt | PAGE: 5]]
SECTION 3 - GENERAL CONDITIONS OF PARTICIPATION
3.1 Bidders shall bear all costs associated with the preparation of their bids.
3.2 The Agency will reimburse no costs, whatever the outcome of the procedure.
3.3 Only firms that hold a valid ISO 9001 certificate on the date of submission of bids are eligible to participate in this procedure.
3.4 A bidder may submit only one bid, either individually or as a member of a joint venture.
[[SOURCE: ITB_Harbour_Sensors.txt | PAGE: 6]]
SECTION 4 - BID SECURITY, SUBMISSION CONTENT AND EVALUATION
4.1 Each bid must be accompanied by a bid guarantee of EUR 15,000, valid for 120 days after the deadline for submission of bids.
4.2 The bid shall include: Form A (Bid Submission Form), Form B (Financial Offer), Form C (Technical Proposal), Form D (Declaration of Honour) and Form E (Joint Venture Agreement, where applicable).
4.3 Bids exceeding the maximum budget will be rejected.
4.4 Evaluation: technical quality 80% and price 20%. Technical sub-criteria: methodology 40%, team 25%, maintenance plan 15%.
4.5 Bids scoring fewer than 70 of 100 technical points will not be considered further.
4.6 Payment: 30% advance payment against an advance payment guarantee of the same amount; 70% upon final acceptance.
4.7 The Supplier will provide monthly progress reports during installation.
